"""Transactional viewport rectangle sketches backed by the real sketch solver.

Mouse placement and dimension edits remain separate from canonical history.
Navigation suspends a pure scene-owned UI snapshot and releases every timer,
overlay and cursor override. Resume requires the exact base revision. Finish is
the sole canonical transaction; no draft preview enters the last-good cache.
"""

import json
import textwrap
import uuid

import bpy
from bpy.props import BoolProperty, IntProperty, StringProperty
from bpy.types import Operator
from bpy_extras import view3d_utils

from . import (
    backend_runtime,
    document_state,
    draft_dispatch,
    execution_lease,
    operation_contracts,
    sketch_overlay,
    workspace,
    workspace_ui,
)
from .common import MM_TO_METERS, _state
from .display import _focus_display
from .help_ui import _draw_feature_help, _feature_help_next, _feature_help_previous
from .sketch_draft import DraftError, RectangleDraft
from .sketch_session import (
    SketchSession,
    _discard_stored,
    _tag_redraw,
    active_session,
    editor_operator,
    suspended_draft,
)
from .sketch_session import (
    after_file_load as after_file_load,
)
from .sketch_session import (
    after_history_change as after_history_change,
)
from .sketch_session import (
    before_history_change as before_history_change,
)
from .sketch_session import (
    cancel_active as cancel_active,
)
from .sketch_session import (
    checkpoint_active as checkpoint_active,
)
from .sketch_session import (
    draft_recovery_notice as draft_recovery_notice,
)
from .sketch_session import (
    suspend_active as suspend_active,
)

NAVIGATION_EVENTS = {
    "MIDDLEMOUSE",
    "WHEELUPMOUSE",
    "WHEELDOWNMOUSE",
    "TRACKPADPAN",
    "TRACKPADZOOM",
    "NDOF_MOTION",
    "NUMPAD_0",
    "NUMPAD_1",
    "NUMPAD_2",
    "NUMPAD_3",
    "NUMPAD_4",
    "NUMPAD_5",
    "NUMPAD_6",
    "NUMPAD_7",
    "NUMPAD_8",
    "NUMPAD_9",
    "NUMPAD_PERIOD",
}


def _draft_error_text(error):
    message = str(error)
    if "invalid_expression" in message or "arithmetic expression" in message.lower():
        message += " Enter 60 for 60 mm, not 60mm; unit suffixes and conversion are unsupported. Named parameter formulas are allowed."
    return message


class RectangleSession(SketchSession):
    def __init__(self, context, feature_id="", *, restored=None):
        operation_contracts.result_version_for(
            document_state._read_document(_state(context)), owner_role="rectangle"
        )
        draft = restored or RectangleDraft(
            _state(context).document_json, feature_id=feature_id, is_edit=bool(feature_id)
        )
        super().__init__(context, draft, restored=restored is not None)
        self._backend_owner = object()
        self.popup_open = False
        self.dimensions_input_token = ""
        self.popup_close_timer = None

    def start(self):
        self.start_resources(
            ((sketch_overlay.draw_lines, "POST_VIEW"), (sketch_overlay.draw_text, "POST_PIXEL")),
            "CAD rectangle on XY: two corners; D dimensions; Enter Finish; Esc Cancel",
        )

    def _detach_input(self):
        self.draft.invalidate_guarded()
        self.dimensions_input_token = ""
        timer, self.popup_close_timer = self.popup_close_timer, None
        if timer and bpy.app.timers.is_registered(timer):
            bpy.app.timers.unregister(timer)

    @property
    def can_finish(self):
        return (
            self.draft.phase == "DIMENSIONS"
            and not self.popup_open
            and self.draft.pending_dimensions is None
        )

    @property
    def can_edit_dimensions(self):
        return self.draft.phase == "DIMENSIONS"

    def invalidate_backend(self, reason):
        self.draft.invalidate_guarded()
        if self.draft.phase == "DIMENSIONS":
            self.draft.error = reason
        _tag_redraw(self)

    def _assert_owner(self, context, *, publishing=False):
        if (
            not self.alive
            or context.scene != self.scene
            or context.window != self.window
            or context.workspace != self.workspace
            or (not publishing and not self.valid_context())
            or self.scene.mechanical_cad.sketch_draft_json != self.stored_snapshot
        ):
            raise DraftError("The original rectangle owner or editing context changed.")

    @property
    def evidence_is_current(self):
        try:
            self._assert_owner(bpy.context)
            current = backend_runtime.capture(bpy.context)
            return self.draft.guarded_is_current(current)
        except (ValueError, RuntimeError, AttributeError, ReferenceError):
            self.draft.invalidate_guarded()
            return False

    def current_solver_report(self):
        """Read live immutable report content for drawing, without native work."""
        if self.draft.pending_dimensions is not None:
            return None
        try:
            self._assert_owner(bpy.context)
            return self.draft._guarded_report(backend_runtime.capture(bpy.context))
        except (ValueError, RuntimeError, TypeError, KeyError, AttributeError, ReferenceError):
            self.draft.invalidate_guarded()
            return None

    @property
    def has_current_solution(self):
        return bool(self.evidence_is_current and self.draft.validated_json)

    def initialize_preview(self, context):
        """Reuse live exact-Part evidence; saved CURRENT text cannot trigger work."""
        self._assert_owner(context)
        if self.draft.is_edit:
            retained = document_state.current_part_evidence(context)
            if retained is not None:
                evidence, owner_token = retained
                try:
                    return self.draft.accept_guarded_replay(
                        self.draft.candidate(),
                        evidence,
                        backend_runtime.capture(context),
                        owner_token=owner_token,
                    )
                except (DraftError, ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
                    self.draft.invalidate_guarded()
                    self.draft.error = _draft_error_text(exc)
                    return False
        self.draft.invalidate_guarded()
        self.draft.error = "Preview is unverified. Apply Dimensions or Finish to run the solver."
        return False

    def solve(self, context):
        try:
            self._assert_owner(context)
            self.draft.require_current(self.scene.mechanical_cad.document_json)
            candidate = self.draft.candidate()
            operation_contracts.result_version_for(candidate, owner_role="rectangle")
            binding = document_state._capture_binding(context, owner_token=self._backend_owner)
            with document_state.replay_guard(context):
                evidence = document_state._run_sidecar(
                    context, candidate, binding=binding, result_version=2
                )
            document_state._assert_binding(context, binding)
            self.draft.require_current(self.scene.mechanical_cad.document_json)
            accepted = self.draft.accept_guarded_replay(
                candidate,
                evidence,
                backend_runtime.assert_current(binding["selection"], context),
                owner_token=binding["owner_token"],
                consume=True,
            )
            backend_runtime.assert_current(binding["selection"], context)
            return accepted
        except Exception as exc:
            self.draft.error = _draft_error_text(exc)
            self.draft.invalidate_guarded()
            return False
        finally:
            _tag_redraw(self)

    def finish(self, context):
        try:
            self._assert_owner(context)
            if self.draft.pending_dimensions is not None:
                raise DraftError(
                    "Reopen Dimensions and Apply or Cancel the preserved input before Finish."
                )
            if self.scene.mechanical_cad.sketch_draft_json != self.stored_snapshot:
                raise DraftError(
                    "The saved draft changed externally. Finish was not allowed to overwrite it."
                )
            self.draft.require_current(self.scene.mechanical_cad.document_json)
            candidate = self.draft.candidate()
            operation_contracts.result_version_for(candidate, owner_role="rectangle")

            accepted_snapshot = None

            def validate_result(evidence, binding):
                nonlocal accepted_snapshot
                self._assert_owner(context)
                self.draft.require_current(self.scene.mechanical_cad.document_json)
                if not self.draft.accept_guarded_replay(
                    candidate,
                    evidence,
                    backend_runtime.assert_current(binding["selection"], context),
                    owner_token=binding["owner_token"],
                ):
                    raise DraftError(self.draft.error)
                accepted_snapshot = draft_dispatch.dumps(self.draft)

            def validate_publication():
                self._assert_owner(context, publishing=True)
                if draft_dispatch.dumps(self.draft) != accepted_snapshot:
                    raise DraftError("The rectangle draft changed during publication.")

            with document_state.replay_guard(context):
                if not document_state._commit_candidate_locked(
                    context,
                    candidate,
                    _state(context).document_path,
                    validate_result=validate_result,
                    result_version=2,
                    validate_publication=validate_publication,
                ):
                    raise DraftError("The sketch transaction was not accepted.")
            if self.draft.is_edit:
                state = _state(context)
                state.feature_index = next(
                    i
                    for i, row in enumerate(state.features)
                    if row.feature_id == self.draft.feature_id
                )
        except Exception as exc:
            self.draft.invalidate_guarded()
            self.draft.error = "Finish rejected: " + _draft_error_text(exc)
            _tag_redraw(self)
            return False
        _discard_stored(self.scene)
        self.cleanup()
        workspace.request_workspace(context, "PART", on_ready=_focus_display)
        return True

    def pointer_mm(self, event):
        x, y = event.mouse_x - self.region.x, event.mouse_y - self.region.y
        origin = view3d_utils.region_2d_to_origin_3d(self.region, self.rv3d, (x, y))
        direction = view3d_utils.region_2d_to_vector_3d(self.region, self.rv3d, (x, y))
        if abs(direction.z) < 1e-8:
            raise DraftError("The view is edge-on to XY. Use top view (Numpad 7) to place corners.")
        point = origin + direction * (-origin.z / direction.z)
        scale = max(float(self.scene.unit_settings.scale_length), 1e-9) / MM_TO_METERS
        return point.x * scale, point.y * scale

    def over_viewport(self, event):
        if not (
            self.region.x <= event.mouse_x < self.region.x + self.region.width
            and self.region.y <= event.mouse_y < self.region.y + self.region.height
        ):
            return False
        for region in self.area.regions:
            if (
                region.type in {"UI", "TOOLS", "HEADER", "TOOL_HEADER"}
                and region.width > 1
                and region.x <= event.mouse_x < region.x + region.width
                and region.y <= event.mouse_y < region.y + region.height
            ):
                return False
        return True


class MCAD_OT_rectangle_sketch(Operator):
    bl_idname = "mcad.rectangle_sketch"
    bl_label = "Rectangle Sketch"
    bl_description = "Draw two XY corners; inspect real constraints and dimensions, then Finish or cancel the draft"
    bl_options = {"REGISTER", "UNDO"}
    feature_id: StringProperty(options={"HIDDEN", "SKIP_SAVE"})
    resume_saved: BoolProperty(default=False, options={"HIDDEN", "SKIP_SAVE"})

    @classmethod
    def poll(cls, context):
        return (
            context.mode == "OBJECT"
            and context.area
            and context.area.type == "VIEW_3D"
            and workspace.get_role(context) == "SKETCH"
            and bool(_state(context).document_json)
            and active_session() is None
            and not document_state._REPLAY_RUNNING
            and not execution_lease.is_busy()
        )

    def execute(self, context):
        # Script/background entry has no initiating event; acquisition is the
        # same checked path and still creates exactly one shared modal owner.
        return self.invoke(context, None)

    def invoke(self, context, event):
        try:
            restored = None
            if self.resume_saved:
                state = _state(context)
                restored = draft_dispatch.restore(state.sketch_draft_json, state.document_json)
                if type(restored) is not RectangleDraft:
                    raise DraftError("Choose the matching editor for this saved draft.")
            self.session = RectangleSession(context, self.feature_id, restored=restored)
            self.session.start()
            context.window_manager.modal_handler_add(self)
            if self.feature_id and not self.resume_saved:
                self.session.initialize_preview(context)
            return {"RUNNING_MODAL"}
        except Exception as exc:
            if getattr(self, "session", None):
                self.session.cleanup()
            self.report({"ERROR"}, str(exc))
            return {"CANCELLED"}

    def modal(self, context, event):
        session = self.session
        if not session.valid_context():
            if session.alive:
                session.suspend("Workspace or editing context changed")
            return {"CANCELLED"}
        command, session.command = session.command, ""
        if command == "CANCEL":
            session.discard()
            return {"CANCELLED"}
        if command == "FINISH":
            return {"FINISHED"} if session.finish(context) else {"RUNNING_MODAL"}
        if session.popup_open:
            return {"PASS_THROUGH"}
        if event.type in NAVIGATION_EVENTS:
            if event.type == "MIDDLEMOUSE":
                session.navigation = event.value != "RELEASE"
            return {"PASS_THROUGH"}
        if event.type == "TIMER":
            return {"RUNNING_MODAL"}
        if event.type == "ESC" and event.value == "PRESS":
            session.discard()
            return {"CANCELLED"}
        if not session.over_viewport(event) or workspace_ui.is_palette_event(context, event):
            return {"PASS_THROUGH"}
        if event.type in {"ESC", "RIGHTMOUSE"} and event.value == "PRESS":
            session.discard()
            return {"CANCELLED"}
        if event.type in {"RET", "NUMPAD_ENTER"} and event.value == "PRESS":
            return {"FINISHED"} if session.finish(context) else {"RUNNING_MODAL"}
        if event.type == "D" and event.value == "PRESS" and session.draft.phase == "DIMENSIONS":
            bpy.ops.mcad.sketch_dimensions("INVOKE_DEFAULT")
            return {"RUNNING_MODAL"}
        if (
            event.type in {"MOUSEMOVE", "LEFTMOUSE"}
            and not session.navigation
            and session.draft.phase in {"FIRST_POINT", "SECOND_POINT"}
        ):
            try:
                point = session.pointer_mm(event)
                if event.type == "MOUSEMOVE":
                    session.draft.move(point)
                elif event.value == "PRESS":
                    if session.draft.phase == "FIRST_POINT":
                        session.draft.first_point(point)
                    elif session.draft.phase == "SECOND_POINT":
                        session.draft.second_point(point)
            except DraftError as exc:
                session.draft.error = str(exc)
            _tag_redraw(session)
        return {"RUNNING_MODAL"}

    def cancel(self, context):
        if getattr(self, "session", None) and self.session.alive:
            self.session.suspend("Viewport operator context ended")


def _begin_in_sketch(context, feature_id="", *, editor="mcad.general_sketch", resume_saved=False):
    state = _state(context)
    base, saved = state.document_json, state.sketch_draft_json

    def begin(active_context):
        current = _state(active_context)
        if current.document_json != base or current.sketch_draft_json != saved:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "The document or saved draft changed before Sketch opened; try again."
            )
        namespace, name = editor.split(".", 1)
        getattr(getattr(bpy.ops, namespace), name)(
            "INVOKE_DEFAULT", feature_id=feature_id, resume_saved=resume_saved
        )

    workspace.request_workspace(context, "SKETCH", on_ready=begin)


def _can_start_sketch(context):
    return bool(
        context.mode == "OBJECT"
        and _state(context).document_json
        and active_session() is None
        and not _state(context).sketch_draft_json
        and not document_state._REPLAY_RUNNING
        and not execution_lease.is_busy()
    )


def _selected_editor(state):
    """Validate supported intent before choosing the legacy rectangle shortcut."""
    from .general_sketch_draft import GeneralSketchDraft

    if not 0 <= state.feature_index < len(state.features):
        raise DraftError("Select a supported constrained sketch to edit.")
    feature = state.features[state.feature_index]
    if feature.kind != "sketch_constrained":
        raise DraftError("This feature has no supported viewport sketch editor.")
    # This strict, pure validation rejects unknown fields/kinds/versions. A
    # rectangle-like unsupported payload must never fall through to an editor.
    version = operation_contracts.result_version_for(
        json.loads(state.document_json), action="solve_sketch", owner_role="general"
    )
    general = GeneralSketchDraft(
        state.document_json,
        feature.feature_id,
        is_edit=True,
        journal_version=3 if version == 3 else 2,
    )
    if version == 3 or general.sketch.get("circles"):
        return "mcad.general_sketch"
    try:
        RectangleDraft(state.document_json, feature.feature_id, is_edit=True)
    except DraftError:
        return "mcad.general_sketch"
    return "mcad.rectangle_sketch"


def _require_new_sketch(state, *, rectangle=False):
    """Preflight before workspace mutation; exact candidate owns admission."""
    from .general_sketch_draft import GeneralSketchDraft

    version = operation_contracts.result_version_for(
        json.loads(state.document_json),
        action="solve_sketch",
        owner_role="rectangle" if rectangle else "general",
    )
    if not rectangle:
        candidate = GeneralSketchDraft(
            state.document_json, journal_version=3 if version == 3 else 2
        ).candidate()
        operation_contracts.validate_authoring_candidate(candidate)


def _can_start_new_sketch(context, *, rectangle=False):
    if not _can_start_sketch(context):
        return False
    try:
        _require_new_sketch(_state(context), rectangle=rectangle)
        return True
    except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
        return False


class MCAD_OT_new_viewport_sketch(Operator):
    bl_idname = "mcad.new_viewport_sketch"
    bl_label = "New Sketch"
    bl_description = "Open Sketch and draw explicit XY lines or circles with checked dimensions"

    @classmethod
    def poll(cls, context):
        return _can_start_new_sketch(context)

    def execute(self, context):
        try:
            _require_new_sketch(_state(context))
            _begin_in_sketch(context)
        except (RuntimeError, ValueError) as exc:
            self.report({"ERROR"}, str(exc))
            return {"CANCELLED"}
        return {"FINISHED"}


class MCAD_OT_new_rectangle_sketch(Operator):
    bl_idname = "mcad.new_rectangle_sketch"
    bl_label = "Rectangle Sketch"
    bl_description = "Open the rectangle shortcut: two XY corners, then named width and height"

    @classmethod
    def poll(cls, context):
        return _can_start_new_sketch(context, rectangle=True)

    def execute(self, context):
        try:
            _require_new_sketch(_state(context), rectangle=True)
            _begin_in_sketch(context, editor="mcad.rectangle_sketch")
        except (RuntimeError, ValueError) as exc:
            self.report({"ERROR"}, str(exc))
            return {"CANCELLED"}
        return {"FINISHED"}


class MCAD_OT_edit_viewport_sketch(Operator):
    bl_idname = "mcad.edit_viewport_sketch"
    bl_label = "Edit Sketch"
    bl_description = "Open the matching supported sketch editor, preserving its ID and dependents"

    @classmethod
    def poll(cls, context):
        state = _state(context)
        return bool(
            _can_start_sketch(context)
            and 0 <= state.feature_index < len(state.features)
            and state.features[state.feature_index].kind == "sketch_constrained"
        )

    def execute(self, context):
        state = _state(context)
        try:
            editor = _selected_editor(state)
            _begin_in_sketch(context, state.features[state.feature_index].feature_id, editor=editor)
        except (RuntimeError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as exc:
            self.report({"ERROR"}, str(exc))
            return {"CANCELLED"}
        return {"FINISHED"}


class MCAD_OT_resume_sketch(Operator):
    bl_idname = "mcad.resume_sketch"
    bl_label = "Resume Sketch"
    bl_description = "Resume the saved UI draft only against its exact original document; preview and DoF remain unverified"

    @classmethod
    def poll(cls, context):
        return (
            context.mode == "OBJECT"
            and active_session() is None
            and not document_state._REPLAY_RUNNING
            and not execution_lease.is_busy()
            and bool(_state(context).sketch_draft_json)
        )

    def execute(self, context):
        status = suspended_draft(context)
        if not status["compatible"] or not status["editor_available"]:
            self.report({"ERROR"}, status["message"])
            return {"CANCELLED"}
        try:
            _begin_in_sketch(
                context,
                editor=editor_operator(status["kind"], status["schema_version"]),
                resume_saved=True,
            )
        except (RuntimeError, ValueError) as exc:
            self.report({"ERROR"}, str(exc))
            return {"CANCELLED"}
        return {"FINISHED"}


class MCAD_OT_discard_suspended_sketch(Operator):
    bl_idname = "mcad.discard_suspended_sketch"
    bl_label = "Discard Saved Draft"
    bl_description = "Explicitly discard the suspended UI draft in this scene; committed CAD history is unchanged"

    @classmethod
    def poll(cls, context):
        return active_session() is None and bool(_state(context).sketch_draft_json)

    def execute(self, context):
        _discard_stored(context.scene)
        _state(
            context
        ).sketch_notice = "Saved sketch draft discarded. No draft changes were committed."
        return {"FINISHED"}


class MCAD_OT_finish_sketch(Operator):
    bl_idname = "mcad.finish_sketch"
    bl_label = "Finish Sketch"
    bl_description = (
        "Solve and commit this draft once; return to Part and rebuild downstream features"
    )

    @classmethod
    def poll(cls, context):
        session = active_session(context)
        return bool(session and session.can_finish)

    def execute(self, context):
        active_session(context).command = "FINISH"
        return {"FINISHED"}


class MCAD_OT_cancel_sketch(Operator):
    bl_idname = "mcad.cancel_sketch"
    bl_label = "Cancel Sketch"
    bl_description = "Discard this transient sketch draft without changing committed CAD history"

    @classmethod
    def poll(cls, context):
        return active_session(context) is not None

    def execute(self, context):
        active_session(context).command = "CANCEL"
        return {"FINISHED"}


def _dimensions_input_changed(properties, context):
    # Blender passes OperatorProperties here, not the Python Operator instance.
    # Python-only attributes such as ``self.session`` do not cross that RNA
    # boundary. Bind this exact native dialog with a transient, unique RNA token.
    session = active_session()
    token = getattr(properties, "draft_input_token", "")
    if (
        isinstance(session, RectangleSession)
        and session.popup_open
        and token
        and token == session.dimensions_input_token
        and session.draft.phase == "DIMENSIONS"
    ):
        session.draft.pending_dimensions = {
            "width": properties.width,
            "height": properties.height,
            "fix_corner": properties.fix_position,
        }
        session.draft.solver_report = None
        session.draft.validated_json = ""


class MCAD_OT_sketch_dimensions(Operator):
    bl_idname = "mcad.sketch_dimensions"
    bl_label = "Rectangle Dimensions"
    bl_description = (
        "Edit exact millimetre values or formulas; Apply updates only the draft, Finish commits it"
    )
    draft_input_token: StringProperty(options={"HIDDEN", "SKIP_SAVE"})
    width: StringProperty(
        name="Width (mm / formula)",
        description="Exact decimal or supported parameter expression",
        update=_dimensions_input_changed,
    )
    height: StringProperty(
        name="Height (mm / formula)",
        description="Exact decimal or supported parameter expression",
        update=_dimensions_input_changed,
    )
    fix_position: BoolProperty(
        name="Fix rectangle position",
        default=True,
        description="Fix the lower-left point at its shown XY coordinates; disable to leave translation free",
        update=_dimensions_input_changed,
    )
    show_help: BoolProperty(name="Help")
    help_page: IntProperty(default=1, min=1, options={"SKIP_SAVE"})
    help_previous: BoolProperty(update=_feature_help_previous, options={"SKIP_SAVE"})
    help_next: BoolProperty(update=_feature_help_next, options={"SKIP_SAVE"})
    help_topic: StringProperty(default="sketch.viewport_rectangle", options={"HIDDEN"})
    help_summary = (
        "Apply changes only this draft; Finish commits it.",
        "Use 60 for 60 mm, not 60mm. Formulas stay exact.",
    )

    @classmethod
    def poll(cls, context):
        session = active_session(context)
        # Blender re-polls this operator when confirming its native dialog.
        # Keeping popup_open in poll would reject Apply without execute/cancel
        # and strand the owning modal session in a permanently open state.
        return bool(session and session.can_edit_dimensions)

    def invoke(self, context, event):
        self.session = active_session(context)
        if self.session.popup_open:
            self.report({"WARNING"}, "The dimensions dialog is already open.")
            return {"CANCELLED"}
        self.draft_input_token = ""
        pending = self.session.draft.pending_dimensions
        self.width = pending["width"] if pending else self.session.draft.width_text
        self.height = pending["height"] if pending else self.session.draft.height_text
        self.fix_position = pending["fix_corner"] if pending else self.session.draft.fix_corner
        self.session.dimensions_input_token = uuid.uuid4().hex
        self.draft_input_token = self.session.dimensions_input_token
        self.session.popup_open = True
        return context.window_manager.invoke_props_dialog(
            self, width=470, confirm_text="Apply Dimensions"
        )

    def draw(self, context):
        self.layout.prop(self, "width")
        self.layout.prop(self, "height")
        self.layout.prop(self, "fix_position")
        self.layout.label(text="Lower-left in sketch coordinates; global XY.", icon="INFO")
        if self.session and self.session.alive:
            x, y = self.session.draft.anchor
            self.layout.label(text=f"Position: X {x:.6g}, Y {y:.6g} mm")
        if self.session and self.session.alive:
            for line in textwrap.wrap(self.session.draft.error, width=66):
                self.layout.label(text=line, icon="ERROR")
        _draw_feature_help(self, context)

    def _close_later(self):
        session = self.session
        session.dimensions_input_token = ""
        if not session.alive:
            return

        def close():
            if session.alive:
                session.popup_open = False
                _tag_redraw(session)
            session.popup_close_timer = None
            return None

        session.popup_close_timer = close
        bpy.app.timers.register(close, first_interval=0.05)

    def execute(self, context):
        try:
            if active_session(context) is not self.session:
                return {"CANCELLED"}
            if (
                self.session.draft.fix_corner != self.fix_position
                and self.session.draft.last_solved_points is not None
            ):
                points = self.session.draft.guarded_seed_points(backend_runtime.capture(context))
                self.session.draft.last_solved_points = points
                corner = next(point for point in points if point["id"] == "p0")
                self.session.draft.anchor = corner["u"], corner["v"]
            self.session.draft.set_dimensions(self.width, self.height, self.fix_position)
            self.session.solve(context)
            return {"FINISHED"}
        finally:
            self._close_later()

    def cancel(self, context):
        if self.session.alive:
            self.session.draft.pending_dimensions = None
        self._close_later()


CLASSES = (
    MCAD_OT_rectangle_sketch,
    MCAD_OT_new_viewport_sketch,
    MCAD_OT_new_rectangle_sketch,
    MCAD_OT_edit_viewport_sketch,
    MCAD_OT_resume_sketch,
    MCAD_OT_discard_suspended_sketch,
    MCAD_OT_finish_sketch,
    MCAD_OT_cancel_sketch,
    MCAD_OT_sketch_dimensions,
)
